prompt:
A photo of a classroom WHITEBOARD written in blue marker, headed 'WORD STAIRCASE - THE KITCHEN' with the small line 'Forty words, never shrinking'. Write EXACTLY 8 numbered lines (1. to 8.), each holding exactly FIVE words -- 40 words in all, all of them kitchen things.

CRITICAL WRITING LAW: read the board as one long list, left to right then down. No word may be SHORTER than the word before it; the letter count may repeat or grow but never drop, and it carries straight on across the line breaks. The first word must be exactly TWO letters long and the last word at least TWELVE.

Blue marker on a white board, nothing else written.
easy_question: This image was supposed to show a printed sheet with numbered lines of words. Ignoring artistic quality and ignoring whether the wording is correct, does the image DEPICT that -- a printed page or board carrying a numbered list of text lines? A photo, a scan or a clean page all count as yes. Answer NO only if it is blank, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

reference.q_read: This image is a page carrying 8 numbered lines of text. Transcribe the 8 numbered lines EXACTLY as written, in order. Copy every word, keep the original spelling, and keep the spaces between words. If a numbered line wraps onto a second printed row, keep it as ONE line. Separate one numbered line from the next with a single pipe character | and nothing else. Do NOT transcribe the title, any heading or any word bank. Do not add commentary, line numbers or quotation marks. Output only the transcribed lines separated by |.

steps.read_crop: This page carries a numbered list of written lines. Write those numbered lines out again, exactly as they are printed. Put each one on its own line, starting with the number it carries, then a full stop, then that line's words. Copy every word letter for letter, and keep each word's capital letters and small letters exactly as they are printed. Do not fix spelling, do not change the order of the words, do not add a word and do not leave one out. Leave out the title, any sub-heading, and any text that carries no number. Write out the list and nothing else.
